description: This is a test class for the `DittoPublicKeyProvider` component, specifically testing the JWT public key retrieval and caching functionality. It uses Mockito and JUnit for mocking dependencies and testing behaviors related to fetching and caching public keys from a remote HTTP endpoint.

classes.name: DittoPublicKeyProviderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class validating the behavior of the PublicKey provider, especially focusing on caching logic and error handling when fetching keys from external HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creating ActorSystem, setting up mock responses, and instantiating the provider under test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Terminates the ActorSystem after tests complete.

methods.name: verifyThatKeyIsCached
methods.description: Tests that the public key is successfully fetched and subsequently retrieved from cache without repeated HTTP calls.

methods.name: verifyThatKeyIsNotCachedOnErrorResponseFromDiscoveryEndpoint
methods.description: Ensures no caching occurs when the discovery endpoint returns an error response.

methods.name: verifyThatKeyIsNotCachedIfResponseDoesNotContainKeyId
methods.description: Verifies that when the keys response does not contain the expected key ID, no key caching happens.

methods.name: mockSuccessfulDiscoveryEndpointRequest
methods.description: Mocks a successful discovery endpoint HTTP response containing the JWKS URI.

methods.name: mockErrorDiscoveryEndpointRequest
methods.description: Mocks an unsuccessful discovery endpoint response with an error status.

methods.name: mockSuccessfulPublicKeysRequest
methods.description: Mocks a successful HTTP response providing a valid JSON Web Key with matching key ID.

methods.name: mockSuccessfulPublicKeysRequestWithoutMatchingKeyId
methods.description: Mocks a successful keys response containing keys that do not match the requested key ID.
